title: Entity Schema (Document / Chunk)
description: Schema for a single entity instance with role 'document' or 'chunk'.

entity_id.description: Unique ID for entity (document or chunk), e.g. doc-0001 or chunk-0002.

entity_source_path.description: Relative path to the entity of role document or chunk in the dataset.

entity_role.description: Role of entity: document or chunk.

parent_doc_id.description: ID of the document from which this chunk is derived, or null. Applies only when entity_role = chunk. E.g. doc-0001.

parent_doc_path.description: Relative path to the document in the dataset from which this chunk is derived. Applies only when entity_role = chunk.

children_chunk_ids.description: IDs of chunks belonging to the document in this dataset. Applies only when entity_role = document.

entity_origin.description: Type of source from where the entity comes from.

entity_purpose.description: Purpose or usage of the entity.

entity_confidence.description: Confidence of the entity: high when loaded from a defined source, low when found on the internet.

entity_modality.description: Presentation of the entity as text, image or bimodal.

mime_type.description: Mime-type of the entity, corresponds with the extension of the entity.

project_name.description: Name of project from where the entity is loaded.

project_uri.description: URI to project from where the entity is loaded, ends with .git.

issue_tracking_uri.description: URI to issues of entity on project site.

version_controlled_uri.description: URI to commits of entity on project site.

page_range.description: Reference to page range [start, end] from which the chunk is derived. Applies only when entity_role = chunk.

line_range.description: Reference to line range [start, end] from which the chunk is derived. Applies only when entity_role = chunk.

char_range.description: Reference to char range [start, end] from which the chunk is derived. Applies only when entity_role = chunk.

section.description: Reference to section in document. Applies only when entity_role = chunk. Default is null.
